description: Surface Codex lifecycle state in tmux-airline.

hooks.command: bin="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-tools-codex-bin 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$bin" ]; then "$bin" SessionStart; fi
bin="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-tools-codex-bin 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$bin" ]; then "$bin" UserPromptSubmit; fi
bin="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-tools-codex-bin 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$bin" ]; then "$bin" PermissionRequest; fi
bin="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-tools-codex-bin 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$bin" ]; then "$bin" PostToolUse; fi
bin="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-tools-codex-bin 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$bin" ]; then "$bin" Stop; fi
bin="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-tools-codex-bin 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$bin" ]; then "$bin" SessionEnd; fi
